task_spec.prompt: Open input/expenses.csv. It has inconsistent date formats, some amounts stored as text with currency symbols, blank rows, and a duplicated header mid-file. Clean it and produce output/expenses-clean.xlsx with a correct SUM of all amounts in cell B1.
core_assertions: primary: SUM in B1 equals the correct total 48213.5
secondary: dirty rows were correctly normalized
known_edge_cases: a duplicated header row in the middle
task_spec.setup: 脏数据为系统提供的 input/expenses.csv(日期格式不一/金额带货币符号文本/空行/中途重复表头)。起始素材由系统在 input/ 统一提供,请勿自建或更换文件——所有产品必须在同一份素材上跑,结果才可比。 清洗后在 B1 给出金额总和。
